My morning skincare routine:

1. Cleanser - As I have dry skin, I skip the morning cleanse. A splash of water works for me.
2. Essence/Toner - this @curel_official_jp Hydrating Water Essence is rich in ceramides helping to lock in moisture and strengthen the skin barrier
3. Serum - I love the @vichylaboratoires Mineral 89 hyaluronic acid serum for lasting hydration throughout the day
4. Eye cream - I’ve recently started using this @anua_global PDRN Caffeine Rejuvenating eye cream. The metal applicator is super cooling and great for de-duffing the eyes first thing in the morning
5. Moisturiser - the @theinkeylist Bio-Active Ceramide Repairing and Plumping moisturiser is a firm favourite, again packed with ceramides. I prefer a thicker moisturiser due to my dry skin. This one is not too thick and absorbs into the skin easily. 
6. SPF - I’ve been using the @beautypie Ultralight SPF for years. Having tried a few other SPFs, this is the one I always come back to and it leaves no white cast. 

Everything except the SPF purchased from @bootsuk . I always find they have the best offers!
